name: Ambient Pressure (with Einheit/Brötzmann, Kevin Richard Martin, Chloe Lula)
description: Part of The Bug's PRESSURE weekender, Ambient Pressure brings together FM Einheit (ex-Einstürzende Neubauten) and Caspar Brötzmann for a visceral improv set, alongside Kevin Richard Martin's live premiere of 'Sub Zero' and Chloe Lula performing her 'Oneiris' album on cello and electronics. This is drone, noise, and experimental sound at its most physically overwhelming—a rare convergence of Berlin's industrial lineage with contemporary ambient practice.
